reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: FMO’s loan of EUR 11.97 million will catalyse EUR 12.3 million from ICCF both for a 14.5 year tenor and mobilise a further EUR 8.1 million from AEF which will have a longer 20-year tenor. This financing will allow for the development, construction, operation and maintenance of a 38MWp solar farm with a total project cost of EUR 40.5 million.
